summary: Modular monolith: Spring Boot + Self-managed PostgreSQL serving Angular, hosted on On-premise Kubernetes (RKE2 / k3s) (your data centre). Estimated $155-450/month (within the $3,000 budget).

architecture_rationale.text: One deployable with strict internal modules for the internal_tool domain: a 6-engineer team gets clear boundaries without distributed-system overhead; modules can be extracted later if scale demands it. Over-engineering guard: microservices rejected: 6 engineer(s) cannot absorb the operational overhead.

frontend.justification: Web - Angular: Chosen because team already works in typescript (team.languages); strong maintainability (5/5) with priorities.maintainability=3; rich client-side interactivity for a internal_tool; strong security (5/5) with priorities.security=3.

alternatives.why_not: Angular scores higher on maintainability and security (fit 5.8 vs 5.9).
Angular scores higher on maintainability and security (fit 5.7 vs 5.9).
